name: blueberrylabs
description: Parent repository: orchestration and documentation only. Application code lives in the backend/ and frontend/ submodules.

scripts.dev: bun run dev:backend & bun run dev:frontend
scripts.setup: bun run submodules && (cd backend && bun install) && (cd frontend && bun install)
scripts.test: bun run test:backend && bun run test:frontend
scripts.lint: cd backend && bun run lint && cd ../frontend && bun run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && bun run typecheck && cd ../frontend && bun run typecheck
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
